steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: ...I'm tired of this.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Nng——!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You're strong. And you've shown me some really cool kung fu.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: But I can't keep playin' with you like this.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Real sorry about this, but you, your buddy, and that traitor, you all gotta die here.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Boys, weapons ready.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Ready!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: So you're going to win with sheer numbers...?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: It ain't so simple, Gambino.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Listen up, once the so-called 'boss' opens fire, that's the official announcement of the end of your affiliation with the Gambino Family. Don't go easy on 'em.

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Waai Fu, this side too...

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: We're getting boxed in.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Hah. We got the Family all split up, and the prey becomes the predator. We got a nice chaotic battle here each fallin' into each other's traps.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: It's just like that time back in Siracusa... But this time, it's a gamble we got no choice but to win.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Too bad you've always been a shit gambler.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: All right. That's enough. Settle down.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: What!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You finally crawled out of your filthy hole?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Mr. Gambino, I am truly sorry, but I've given you and your Family so many chances.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: We got no trust between us at all. You really think I'd hand the Family over to some non-Sicilian freak?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Sicilian. While I have not once in my life set foot in a Siracusan city, I do know that you are unworthy of describing yourself as such.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: ...What are you gonna do?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: The time for questions has passed, young man. And you have broken the rules far too many times.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Once was your transgression, another was yours. But it matters not. You have both overstepped your bounds.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You goin' back on your deal?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I made no deal.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Hmph. You really think you can take us?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You sit on a throne in a stinking sewer, telling desperate people who got no choice but to throw down their lives what to do. That's you.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: It behooves you, as head of your household, to broaden your horizons.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Compared to everything we have been through, your little Siracusan fiasco was a stubbed toe.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Shut up!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Have you ever seen a true onslaught? What it means to truly have barbarians at your gates?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: When moving cities crash against one another, smoke chokes the skies, and the dying infected rot away by cesspools, crying in hopeless agony?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You know nothing. And yet you think to fight a city.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: (He's immensely powerful... him and that woman with him...)

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: (Shit, we have to at least stop provoking the Rat King... now is not the time...)

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You think you stand for all of Lungmen?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Lungmen certainly cannot stand for me.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Enough talk! Haah——!

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: No one will permit you to strike this old man.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: Get back, Waai Fu!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Out of my way!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Thank you. You are Ah Fil. I've heard your story.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: You're the one Uncle always talks about...

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Heh, my old friend.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I thank you for helping Lungmen put a stop to them. And I thank you for your pursuit of justice.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Now, please leave.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I promised many times to many people that I would not let the children get mixed up in such matters.

steps.name: Jaye
steps.text: ...Waai Fu.

steps.name: Waai Fu
steps.text: Fine.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: The children are gone. And with them your hope of victory.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Put down your weapons, kneel before me, and your 'Family' will have at least some chance to survive.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Do you really think your threats mean anything?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...You are on our land. It means to us what Siracusa means to you. You must know this much.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You still have some chips on the table, young man. Wouldn't you like to save them?

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Qui- quicksand?! Run!

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Aaaaaagh! My hand! D- don't touch the sand!

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: You cocky——

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Calm yourself, young man. I don't need my hands to stop your sword.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Look around you at your companions. This city has bled so much already. I really don't want to see 'Family' killing one another on the program.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: This is your last chance.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: I ain't gonna turn coward again. Leaving Siracusa was the last step backwards for my Family.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: I'd rather die here like a true Sicilian than ever let the enemy see me run off with my tail between my legs.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Perhaps in your mind, this is the way for a warrior to behave. But for a leader, going too far is as bad as not going far enough.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You should reflect, and introspect. Unfortunately, it is too late.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Aaaagh!!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: ...This is the end, Gambino. You should never have bet the whole Family on this.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Capone, you, you son of a——!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Calm down. We don't want you to go out too hard.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Gah!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Funny. You don't look surprised at all. Were you waiting for me to do this?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: What are you thinking, backstabbing boss-killer?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I'll offer up the whole Family. We're gonna live here, in Lungmen. And we're not gonna fall on our swords for no good reason.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: It's too bad... if you were truly willing to work together, that woman never would have exiled you from Siracusa.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You know a lot about us... But I'm not gonna ask. It's Lungmen.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Indeed. It's Lungmen.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You mean I should be easier on you, since you're willing to personally discipline the disobedient?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: My Family will take orders from you.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: 'Your Family.'

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You are simply describing the situation as it is. You made so many miscalculations you have no other choice.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Right. It's been a hell of a night. I've had a lotta setbacks. But that's business.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Mmm... Business.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You're absolutely right. This is an excellent deal. Fair and equitable.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Then——!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: But, Mr. Capone, it's Lungmen.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: It's not me.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I have no need of your loyalty. Never did.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You... from the very beginning, you were...

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: It's what it is. We gotta survive.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: When you tried to worm your way into Lungmen, your mutual suspicion ground turned you up into a sheet of sand. A stone is hard to break. But sand? I can easily scoop up a handful.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I have no love of trickery. It's really no fun at all. What matters is what I said a few minutes ago: I truly do not wish to see family massacre family...

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: And yet you did harm to your own brother, right in front of me.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Now for this, I would not say you've crossed the ultimate line. So I will not kill you.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: It's just that, since you disobeyed me, I'm afraid I have no need of such a crafty and conniving friend.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You...! You had these moles in the Family from the very beginning! And you waited until we got at each other's throats, and then you...!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Gah!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You're wasting your life on idle words, young man.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Heh... while you toyed around with the power over them, your underlings were mulling it all over for you. Truly remarkable.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Their loyalty has bought them a chance to survive in Lungmen. And a life for each of you as well.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Now then, you have seen for yourselves the choices made by these two leaders, and now the time has come for you to fulfill your commitments.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: ...Heh.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Rat King. No, Lin. Lin Gray, you're more Sicilian than either of us.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You tore my honor to shreds, and then you let me live? Are you trying to humiliate me?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Astonishing. To save your life, you don't hesitate to draw a sword on your own brother, your own leader, and yet when I offer to let you live, you are determined to die?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I thought only the one out cold over there would gnash his teeth at me so.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: That's because I too am 'Sicilian.'

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Or I guess I should ask if you really thought you could wipe out one of Siracusa's 'Families' and get away with it?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Idle threats. You must know that nobody will go to war over an erased Family. Take a step back and see that even though some hopeless, scattered warriors may ignorantly think to act...

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...I say let them come. Let them be torn to shreds by the true rage of this city.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Grr!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You alone have no power to stand against us.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Now. Go.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: ...I guess my life just has to go on for now, but one day you'll regret that you didn't kill me, a true Sicilian, today.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: No question.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...If I were to send a man to kill him now, what would you do?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: You wouldn't do that.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: But what he said is true. I have no reason to be so lenient with a Siracusan mafioso.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: We had a deal. When we came face to face, we'd defect, and you'd let the others go.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Unless, of course, the remaining mobsters force a fight to the death.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Heh heh. Don't worry. He didn't mean that. He's simply a coward who wants to live. But his anger is not feigned.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: An unrighteous man has nothing for which to live.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Remarkable. His negligible dignity saved his life, in the end.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: ...Thanks.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Go. It is time to bring this evening to its conclusion.
